title: T008 — accumulator overflow
purpose: An accumulator whose running value exceeds engine limits should fail the transform.
trigger: Accumulating values past the accumulator's numeric capacity.
fix: Reduce the magnitude of accumulated values or use a wider numeric representation.
notes: The engine currently enforces no overflow bound on %accumulate; the transform succeeds and the stable T008 code is not yet emitted.
Documented for completeness so the catalog covers every defined transform error code.
